final: WITH inv AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_qty, (AVG(derived_product_cost) - AVG(derived_total_cost)) / AVG(derived_total_cost) AS rel_gap FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_qty) AS o FROM inv) SELECT inv.invoice_number, inv.avg_qty, inv.rel_gap, inv.avg_qty - overall.o AS diff_above_overall FROM inv, overall WHERE inv.avg_qty > overall.o ORDER BY diff_above_overall DESC LIMIT 10
